Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Aaron Finch and David Warner will open the batting for Australia. Maheesh Theekshana will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

The bowlers have justified Aaron Finch's decision to bowl first! What a scintillating performance this was from the visitors! After being put onto the back foot early in the innings but they fought back well and demolished the Lankan batting lineup in the last ten overs. Josh Hazlewood grabbed three wickets in one over which was probably the turning point. He was definitely the leader of the pack as he picked up four wickets and gave away just 16 runs in his spell. Mitchell Starc was exceptional as well, as he ended with 3 wickets by his name. It's up to the batters now, they have a great opportunity to take a lead in this series. Can they do so? Will find out soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

After being put into bat first, Sri Lanka got off to a flying start. They scored 50 runs and lost just one wicket at the end of the Powerplay. Pathum Nissanka and Charith Asalanka put on a good partnership of 63 runs before Nissanka perished for a solid 38. That was the only partnership that flourished for Sri Lanka. Post that it all went downhill for the hosts. They lost 9 wickets within 28 runs. Sri Lanka do have a strong bowling attack, but defending a below-par target of 129 is going to be a challenge.

What a stupendous bowling performance we have just witnessed! From cruising at 100 for 1 Sri Lanka have been bundled out for just 128! Aaron Finch and his men will definitely be the happier side going into this break, while Sri Lanka will be disappointed after the start they got. They face a tough task ahead of them from here on.

OUT! That is the end of Sri Lanka's inning! A length ball, outside off. Maheesh Theekshana swings across and slices it high and over covers. David Warner runs to his right from mid off and takes a superb diving catch. He made it look so easy. Sri Lanka are all out on 128.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Dot again! Length ball, outside off. Maheesh Theekshana pushes it straight to point.
Length ball, on top of off. Maheesh Theekshana punches it to point.

Not out it is! Length ball, slanting around leg. Nuwan Thushara makes room and tries to fend it away but misses. A stifled appeal for a caught behind and not given. Australia take the review. UltraEdge shows nothing on it.
Full and on leg. Thushara wrists it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, outside off. Nuwan works it to covers.
Nuwan Thushara comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Another simple catch and another wicket for Starc! Full ball, angling across. Hasaranga tries to play with the angle but miscues it completely. The ball lobs to point where Aaron Finch backtracks and takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Angles it one on the pads, nudged to square leg for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! A low full toss, around off. Chameera tries to go over mid off but cue ends his shot and hits it to mid off where David Warner takes an easy catch. Starc would love to take the remaining wickets now.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Mitchell Starc comes to bowl his final over.
Fuller, slower and on middle. Dushmantha Chameera miscues his drive and spoons it to the vacant mid on region for a single.
Outside off. Hasaranga guides it to third man for a single.
Hits the hard length, on off. Hasaranga gets on top of it and blocks it out.
FOUR! Crucial runs for the Lankans! Overpitched and outside off. Hasaranga drives it through covers for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Hasaranga looks to slash at it but misses.
Shorter and around middle. Hasaranga pulls it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Josh Hazlewood (3-0-8-4) is back on!
Kane rolls his fingers on it, length and on leg. Dushmantha Chameera looks to work it away but gets hit on the pads. Australia will look to make sure they do not let the tail wag now.
Too full now, on off. Chameera digs it out back to the bowler.
A slower full ball, tailing on the pads. Chameera misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Shorter and on middle. Hasaranga works it to wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Length and outside off. Hasaranga strokes it to backward point.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another excellent display of fielding from Australia! A length ball, slanting on off. Chamika Karunaratne turns it to mid-wicket and hurls across for a quick single. Smith there, with a beautiful piece of fielding. He collects the ball with one hand and throws it at the bowler's end and hits bulls eye. The ball was rolling on the other side to the end, to the fence but Smith was pretty confident with his fielding. The replay shows Chamika Karunaratne was out by a fine margin. Out it is. Dushmantha Chameera walks out to bat now.
Run out chance! There is a direct hit at the bowler's end. The replay shows that Chamika Karunaratne is short of his ground. He has to walk back!
We are ready to resume after that short delay. The players have made their way out in the middle. Kane Richardson comes to bowl.
UPDATE - 8.26 pm (2.56 pm GMT) - Oh, dear! It has started to drizzle and the covers are coming on. But hang on, it looks like it was just a passing shower and the covers are already coming off.
Slower short ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Length and on off. Hasaranga drops it to point for one.
Chamika Karunaratne walks out to bat.

OUT! Charith Asalanka is RUN OUT! This was a very wrong move knowing Asalanka was the only known batter out there. It was not needed at the moment. A length ball, slower and outside off. Charith Asalanka swings across and misses. Wade fumbles to collect and the batters try to take advantage of it as they run across for a quick single. Wade collects and throws it to Marsh who clips the bails off in a flash. It is taken upstairs and Asalanka was well short.
Fuller and on middle. Hasaranga tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Much needed one! First one in 22 balls! A length ball, outside off. Hasaranga opens the face of the bat and steers it past backward point for a boundary.
Bangs a bouncer and on middle. Hasaranga tries to play it over the keeper but fails to connect.
Mitchell Marsh is back on.
Tosses it up, tad quicker, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga drives it down to long off for a single.
Lovely shot! Fuller one, outside off. Charith Asalanka waits for it, opens the face of the bat, and guides it down to third ma. Three taken!
Loopy ball, outside off, full in length. Wanindu Hasaranga drives it firmly towards the fielder at cover for a single. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Tad fuller again, around off. Charith Asalanka backs away and tries to push this on the off side, but the ball goes off the under-edge to third man.
Tosses it up, fuller, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga pushes it off the front foot towards long off for a single. A single.
Back of a length, around middle. Charith Asalanka knocks it down to long on for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes in.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! Sri Lanka are falling apart here! What an over this is turning out to be from Josh Hazlewood! His third wicket in this over and fourth overall. Another top delivery from him A length ball, nipping back in, around middle and leg. Dasun Shanaka shuffles across and tries to flick this but he misses and gets rapped on his pads. A huge appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger.  Dasun Shanaka ops for a review. No bat involved, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates three reds. Dasun Shanaka has to walk back!
Shortish ball, around middle. Dasun Shanaka works it away towards mid-wicket. No run there!
Dasun Shanaka walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Bhanuka Rajapaksa departs for a golden duck! Josh Hazlewood grabs his third wicket and Sri Lanka have lost their fourth. The hosts are in a spot of bother now. Slower ball, outside off, on a length. Bhanuka Rajapaksa tries to guide this towards third man but he manages to get a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Matthew Wade behind the stumps makes no mistake. They appeal and up goes the finger. The crowd was pumped for Bhanuka but no entertainment this time from him. Australia on top!
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around middle. Charith Asalanka miscues his pull shot towards mid off. A quick single taken!
Swing and a miss! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Charith Asalanka hangs back and tries to cut this way but he misses.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack and strikes straightaway. Wickets in quick succession for Australia and Sri Lanka are now 3 down. Josh Hazlewood drops it short, around middle. Kusal Mendis back away, and looks to pull this but the ball goes off his top edge and lobs up towards mid off. Ashton Agar runs forward and takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Josh Hazlewood (2-0-7-1) is back on.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Charith Asalanka presses forward and taps it towards mid-wicket. Lovely over from Ashton Agar, just 2 runs off it.
Spinning away, outside off, short in length. Kusal Mendis pushes off the back foot through cover for a single.
Make that three! Fullish ball, around middle and leg. Kusal Mendis blocks it out.
Quicker, flatter, darting it on the pads. Kusal Mendis blocks it out. Two dots in a row now.
Outside off, pitches it up again. Kusal Mendis hangs back and dabs it towards short third man.
Tosses it up, fuller, around middle. Charith Asalanka sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Kusal Mendis comes in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Mitchell Starc has the last laugh! He gets rid of Pathum Nissanka now and Sri Lanka have lost their second wicket. Wicket at a good time for Australia once again. A slower ball on this occasion, yorker-length delivery, on the off pole. Pathum Nissanka tries to play across the line and sweep this one the leg side but he misses. The ball goes on to hit the off pole.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Pathum Nissanka walks across and tries to scoop this but he misses.
FOUR! Top shot! On a length, around middle. Pathum Nissanka makes room and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes one bounce over the ropes for a boundary.

FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for Sri Lanka! Mitchell Starc hits the deck hard, too short on this occasion, around middle. Pathum Nissanka looks to pull but he misses. Matthew Wade jumps and fails to catch the ball as well. Boundary!
A fuller ball from over the wicket, outside off. Pathum Nissanka shuffles across and tries to sweep this but he misses and gets rapped on his pads.

Pathum Nissanka takes the aerial route this time! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Pathum Nissanka lifts it over extra-cover. The ball will not race away to the boundary but the batters pick up two runs.
On a length, around middle. Charith Asalanka looks to pull this but the ball goes off the inner half of his bat towards deep square leg. Single taken!

Tad quicker, this one comes in with the arm, around middle and leg. Pathum Nissanka steps down the track and tries to flick this away but he misses and gets hit on his pad. A stifled appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no. That was probably sliding down leg.
SIX! BOOM! Lovely shot! A loopy one, spinning away a tad, outside off. Pathum Nissanka gets down on his knee and slog-sweeps this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Tad quicker, outside off, fuller ball. Charith Asalanka presses forward and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Pathum Nissanka drills it towards long off and takes a single.
Full again, around off. Charith Asalanka shimmies down the pitch and sweeps it straight to the fielder at long on. Single taken!
Slower through the air, tosses it up, very full, around off. Charith Asalanka pushes it to the left of the bowler. Ashton Agar dives to his left and does well to stop the ball.
Full and outside off, Asalanka hits it to deep cover for a run.

DROPPED! Steven Smith is the culprit! This is full and around off. Nissanka heaves and tries to clear the longer side of the ground, to deep mid-wicket. Steven Smith runs to his right and collects it but fumbles it as he meets the ground. The ball rolls back but Smith does well to flick it away. A single.
Length ball, just outside off. Nissanka tries to go inside-out but mistimes it and hits it to mid off where the fielder collects it on a boundary.
Outside off, dabbed to short third man for a single.

FOUR! Streaky! Hits the hard length, outside off. Asalanka looks to cut but gets outside edge again. This time Wade tries to collect but the ball evades him and runs away to the third man fence. Two in a row now! Just what the host wanted.

FOUR! Welcome boundary! A length ball, angling outside off. Asalanka looks to drive on the up but gets a thick outside edge to deep backward point. Josh Hazlewood runs across from deep point and tumbles to keep the ball away. He gets a hand on it but the ball hits him on the back and deflects over the ropes. Good effort but a boundary.
Kane Richardson (1-0-10-0) comes back into the attack.
Full and down the leg side. Asalanka sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Around off. Pathum Nissanka skips down and tucks it to long on for a single.

Australia lose the review! Another swing and a miss from Pathum Nissanka. Fraction short and outside off. Pathum Nissanka tries to reverse-hit again but misses. Wade puts in an appeal and Maxwell joins him but nothing from the umpire. Australia take the review! Aaron Finch was not fully convinced but they eventually take it. UltraEdge shows no bat there. Flat line and Pathum Nissanka survives.
Around off, tossed up, swept to deep square leg for a couple.
Short again, quicker this time, outside off. Pathum Nissanka tries to reverse-hit but misses.
Shorter and outside off, spinning in. Pathum Nissanka waits on the back foot and dabs it past short third man for a brace. Deft touch.
Glenn Maxwell comes back to bowl.
Fuller and angling on off. Pathum Nissanka makes room and looks to go over covers but splices it to third man for a single. Decent few overs from Australia. Boundaries have dried up a bit.
Around off, pushed through point for one more.

A direct hit and Charith Asalanka was in real trouble! Might have been walking straight back to the pavilion. Length ball, on off. Nissanka knocks it in front of covers and scampers across for a quick single. Ashton Agar collects and whips a throw at the keeper's end but misses. Asalanka puts in a dive but luckily Agar misses his shot.
Too full and around middle. Asalanka whips it in front of square on the leg side for one.
Pitched up, outside off. Asalanka leans and drives it through covers for a brace.
Fuller and slanting around leg. Asalanka hits it to mid-wicket.
Mitchell Starc comes into the attack. He went for 7 runs in his first over.
Another single to end the over! Decent start by Agar! Tossed up, on off. Asalanka works to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Darted on the pads, clipped to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Floated on middle, touch fuller, it is flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Charith Asalanka shuffles across and hits it back to Agar.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, cut away wide of deep point for a couple of runs.
Ashton Agar comes into the attack.
Dot to end the over but a successful Powerplay for Sri Lanka as they are at 50 for 1! Length and around middle. Charith Asalanka keeps it out on the off side.
Length and outside off. Asalanka drops it to point. No run there.
FOUR! Good shot! Short of a length, on middle. Asalanka is a touch early on his pull shot but hits it to the vacant deep backward square region and bags a boundary. 50 up for Sri Lanka...
Length ball, around off. Asalanka taps it to the right of the bowler.

SIX! BOOM! High and handsome! Fuller and in the slot, on middle. Asalanka swung across earlier but failed to connect but this time connects it beautifully and dispatches it high over mid-wicket for a biggie.
On a length and around middle. Asalanka defends it right under his eyes.
Kane Richardson to bowl now.
Back of a length, outside off. Charith Asalanka dabs it through backward point and takes a single. He retains the strike. End of a successful over from Josh Hazlewood!
Fullish ball, outside off. Charith Asalanka prods forward and blocks it out watchfully.
Swing and a miss! Another length delivery, shaping away outside off. Charith Asalanka backs away and looks to pull this but fails to get any connection on that.
Beaten! On a length, swinging away, outside off. Charith Asalanka stays in his crease and looks to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Charith Asalanka is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Josh Hazlewood strikes and draws first blood! Much-needed wicket for Australia as Danushka Gunathilaka was looking dangerous! Josh Hazlewood drops it short this time, around off, shaping away just a tad. Danushka Gunathilaka makes room and slashes it towards deep point. The ball flies high and goes straight to Mitchell Marsh who pouches it safely. A good start from Danushka Gunathilaka but he fails to go on.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Marsh b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! WOW! He has made that look so easy! On a length, around middle and off. Danushka Gunathilaka shuffles across, gets down on his knee and scoops it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.

Back of a length, around middle. Danushka Gunathilaka punches it off the back foot towards mid off and scapers across to the other end for a quick single. There was a throw at the keeper's end, but Pathum Nissanka dives in to make his ground.
Slower through the air, on middle, fuller in length. Pathum Nissanka sweeps this towards deep square leg. Single taken!
Shorter this time, around middle, spinning away a tad. Danushka Gunathilaka makes room and pushes it off the back foot towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Danushka Gunathilaka is on the charge! A fuller one, around middle. Danushka Gunathilaka gets down on his knee and sweeps it over square leg for another boundary in the over.
Another loopy one, fuller, around middle. Pathum Nissanka flicks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Pathum Nissanka greets Glenn Maxwell with a boundary! A loopy ball, fuller, around middle. Pathum Nissanka dances down the track and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
Change in bowling! Glenn Maxwell is into the attack.
Change of pace this time! A length ball, around off. Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it off the back past cover for a brace. Good over for Sri Lanka 14 runs from it.
SIX! Bang! On a length again, around middle. Danushka Gunathilaka shuffles across and scoops it over the keeper's head all the way for a biggie.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! A length ball, around middle and off. Danushka Gunathilaka makes room and tonks it over the fielder at mid off for a boundary.
A length ball, around middle. Pathum Nissanka drags it with the inner half of his bat towards deep square leg. Single taken!

Another length ball, nipping in, around middle. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to heave this but the ball goes off his inside edge back onto the pads and rolls towards the off side. The batters leave their crease for a quick single, Mitchell Marsh runs forward and kicks the ball onto the stumps at the keeper's end but Pathum Nissanka was well in.
Swing and a miss! Mitchell Marsh begins with a length from over the wicket, outside off. Danushka Gunathilaka backs away and swings his bat but he fails to get any connection on it.
Mitchell Marsh is into the attack. It looks like Mitchell Starc is still struggling or this might be a tactical change as well. Time will tell...
Back of a length, some width on offer this time. Pathum Nissanka hangs back and cuts it towards the fielder at point. Tidy start from Josh Hazlewood, just two runs off it.
Quick single! Around off, length delivery. Danushka Gunathilaka taps it towards cover and runs across to the other end.
Josh Hazlewood maintains the same length, on the pads this time. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to pull this but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pad.
On a length, around middle and off. Danushka Gunathilaka makes room and pushes it to the fielder at mid off. Some intent shown here by Danushka Gunathilaka this time!
Another length delivery, outside off. Pathum Nissanka dabs it towards point and scampers across to the other end.
Josh Hazlewood comes over the wicket, serves a length ball, around off, at 132 clicks. Pathum Nissanka defends it out off the back foot.
Good-length delivery, around the off pole, at 141 clicks. Danushka Gunathilaka blocks it out solidly. 7 runs off the first over!
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Josh Hazlewood. One slip in place.
Halt in play... Mitchell Starc has some issues with a finger. The physio is out and it is his bowling hand as well. So, it will need some assistance.
Wide! Down the leg side, pitches it up again. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to flick this but he misses it this time. Wide given.
Runs straightaway for Danushka Gunathilaka! Mitchell Starc serves this one the pads, on a fullish length. Danushka Gunathilaka flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Outside off, fuller ball again. Pathum Nissanka presses forward and drives it past the fielder at mid off. Three taken. Pathum Nissanka gets off the mark with that!
Tad fuller, around off. Pathum Nissanka pushes it back to the bowler.

An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! A length ball, tailing back in, around middle and off, at around 141 clicks. Pathum Nissanka leans forward and looks to defend this but he manages to get a big inside edge back onto his pads.
Another full-length delivery, outside off. Pathum Nissanka opens the face of the bat and taps it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Wide! Mitchell Starc begins with a fuller ball, wide of off, shaping away. Pathum Nissanka leaves it alone. Wide called! Sri Lanka are up and running!

We are all set for the action. The players of Australia are out in the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Danushka Gunathilaka are the openers of Sri Lanka. Mitchell Starc is all set to steam in with a fresh new ball.
Both the teams line up for their respective national anthems. It is Australia's first followed by Sri Lanka's. The players also remember the passing away of late Aussie great - Andrew Symonds.
Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka says the boys have grown up in confidence after playing some franchise cricket. Adds that he is happy to bat first, looks like a good wicket.

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia says they are going to bowl first, looks like a good surface and they will want to chase. Mentions that Glenn Maxwell is much better than a part-time spinner, he can be aggressive but yes, they are going with one frontline spinner and backing Maxwell.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold is down near the pitch. He says it's a belter of a pitch. Adds that it's an even pitch, but on the dry side. Little cracks on it, but there will be good bounce and carry. All the players will have a smile on their faces. Mentions that the toss will not matter much, also there is no dew expected.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Danushka Gunathilaka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Nuwan Thushara.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Mitchell Marsh, Glenn Maxwell, Steven Smith, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade (WK), Ashton Agar, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and they will BOWL first!

The weather in Colombo seems cloudy and there is a possibility of rain as well. But let’s hope we face no interruptions and we get to witness a full game. We have an exciting battle to look forward to. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

Talking about a lethal bowling attack, Sri Lanka's main strength is their bowling unit. Wanindu Hasaranga, Maheesh Theekshana, and Dushmantha Chameera form the core of their attack and they prove to be a real threat to the opposition. However, it’s their batting that needs to step up. They have added Bhanuka Rajapaksa to their playing XI and looking at his recent form he could prove to be a boon for them.

Both these sides have already named their playing XI. Australia’s big guns, David Warner, Mitchell Marsh, and Glenn Maxwell, who had missed the previous T20I against Pakistan, have returned to the side. They all did well in the recently concluded Indian T20 League and will be looking to replicate the same in this game as well. However, the likes of Aaron Finch and Steven Smith will have to prove their worth in the shortest format and display their magic. They will be missing the services of Pat Cummins and Adam Zampa, but they still do have a lethal bowling attack.

Hello and a warm welcome folks! It’s time for the first T20I of this three-match T20I series between Sri Lanka and Australia at the R.Premadasa Stadium, Colombo. The last time these two sides met Australia put on a dominant performance and won the series 4-1. Sri Lanka did put on a great show but failed to get over the line. However, things are different now and they will be hoping to roar in their own den and come out on top this time. Both teams are filled with power-packed players and we can expect nothing less than a cracker of a contest.
... MATCH DAY ...
